clips.title: The story
paras: In Dolanaar, Jannok Breezesong trains young night elf rogues. He teaches stealth, cunning, and bladecraft to kaldorei setting out beneath the World Tree's boughs.

Beneath Dolanaar's boughs, Jannok Breezesong teaches novice night elf rogues. He trains those who work quietly beyond the ranks of Teldrassil's sentinels and druids. His lessons teach them to stalk through shadows, strike from behind, and survive unseen among the boughs. When rogues finish their first lessons in Dolanaar, Jannok sends them to more experienced trainers in Darnassus.
